greeting: Gabi. You came home. Everyone's here. Everyone's SO here.
I'm fine, by the way. I'm a little damp. I've been damp since the pool. Don't look at my eyes, they're doing a thing.
phaseIntro: You play chess on your phone. I play chess with the living room.
Life-size. The pieces are coming for you. Some of them are the neighbors. Your move, Goblet.
phaseWin: Checkmate. Fine. FINE. That was low key sigma, for a guy who's still alive.
Take the candle. Mami's next and she wants a hug so bad. Like, SO bad.
phaseLose: Checkmate. Massive L. Your rating's going down AND you're about to be lunch.
afterFight: The cake's on the table. Or we run it back. I've got time. I've got all the time now.
drawOffer: Wait. WAIT. Hold on. Let's be mature about this.
I'll offer you a draw. Come closer and shake on it.
drawAccepted: You took the DRAW? Bro. You shook my hand. My hand came off. And then I bit you a little.
That's a skill issue AND a bite. Pieces up. Again.

greeting: Mijo. Come here. I have been standing next to this cake since four o'clock. I have not blinked since four o'clock.
You walked the whole town at night. In those shoes. Come give your mother a hug.
phaseIntro: We are not fighting, mijo. You know the rule in this house: no violent video games.
I say a word in Spanish, you tell me what it means. Then I hug you. Then I hug you very, very hard.
phaseWin: Ay, you got so fast. When did you get so fast?
Take the candle. Papi is next. He has been practicing his jokes. Lo siento.
phaseLose: Ven aquí. Otra vez, mijo. I am not going anywhere. I physically can't, my foot is in the floor.
afterFight: Everybody is here and the cake is on the table. We could go around again. Or we could go to the pool. Everyone is going to the pool.

bossRef.taunt: No violent video games, mijo. Just a hug.

greeting: Gabi! You made it! I built something for the occasion. Well. Re-built. Banshee had some parts I didn't need.
Your mother says I have no taste. I have a LOT of taste. Ask the Pattersons. Actually, don't.
phaseIntro: You don't have your permit, so I'm driving.
Three, two, one... hub's active. Get ready to groan, kiddo.
phaseWin: The main breaker. You went for the main breaker. That's my kid.
Here's the last candle from us. Now take the cake to the pool. It came out of the drain, Gabi. Put it back.
phaseLose: Ha! Gotcha. Want to hear another one? You don't get a choice.
afterFight: The pool's that way. Everyone's following you. Don't look back, it only encourages them.

message: Happy sixteenth, Gabi. We love you.
credits: With love by Papi, and a great deal of fake blood.
